criteria.requirement: Add floor/ceil/lower/higher(value,default=MISSING) to list/keyed list/set/dict. Use container bisect ordering: floor last <=, ceil first >=, lower strict predecessor, higher strict successor; keyed comparisons follow sorting key, including reverse keys and duplicate-key ties. Return existing value (dict returns key/value pair) preserving identity. Missing raises KeyError unless any explicit default, including None/False, is supplied. Existing indexing/bisect behavior unchanged.
